throughput_requirements: Target sustained throughput: 1800 QPS of 2k-token chat requests across N. America primary + EU secondary (peak bursts up to 4k QPS for 20 minutes). Token throughput target ~25k tokens/sec aggregate. Concurrency target: support 300 concurrent live sessions with KV cache hit-rate > 85%.
latency_slos: Primary SLOs: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms for 2k-context chat on dedicated tier. Tail-protection required during burst windows. RTO target for region failover: < 2 minutes for routing switch; RPO: tolerate up to 15s lost in-flight KV state (acceptable tradeoff).
reserved_gpu_planning: Helion proposed reserve: 8xH100 per region (NA + EU) as baseline for 70B FP16. Plan includes burst pool of additional 4 GPUs per region for scheduled spikes. SE recommends evaluation of 8xH100 + 2xA100 cold standby to reduce cost and support fast scale; suggested autoscale policy with hard cap and graceful draining. Need explicit billing model for burst usage beyond reservation.
reliability_and_fallback_design: Design proposal: active-active deployment (NA + EU) with smart-routing layer (priority: local region -> sibling region -> fallback model variant). Fallback rules: when local queued requests > 85% of capacity OR p95 latency > 150ms for 2 consecutive 60s windows, begin model-variant fallback (route new requests to 13B int8 variant or quantized 33B). Fallback must preserve signature + minimal post-processing to avoid user-visible regressions. KV/prefix caching persisted to a cross-region replicated cache with per-request affinity to reduce cold-starts. Circuit-breaker thresholds + progressive rollback are required. Regular DR tests (quarterly) and runbook ownership with Helion on-call identified.
sla_negotiation_points: Uptime target: 99.95% for Dedicated service (region-level), with credit schedule for breaches
Incident response: P1 acknowledgement < 30 minutes, P1 mitigation target < 4 hours
Performance credits tied to p95 and p99 SLO misses (sliding window, capped monthly)
Scheduled maintenance windows negotiated to be < 4 hours and communicated 72h in advance
DR exercises: annual full failover test; Redwood to provide postmortem and remediation plan
Support: 24/7 P1 escalation path + named SE during POC and first 90 days
poc_plan: 72-hour sustained stress run: two regions in active-active, run synthetic workload (mix chat + rerank) with stepwise traffic (25/50/75/100% of projected peak). Measure p50/p95/p99, GPU utilization, queue depth, cache hit-rate. Run three failure scenarios: 1) region outage, 2) sustained CPU/GPU throttling, 3) network partition causing increased cross-region latency. Deliverable: perf report + recommended reserved GPU count + revised SLA.
operational_integration: Helion requires support for SAML SSO into Redwood Console, exportable audit logs for 2 years, per-route token cost breakdown, and a webhook for incident alerts. Also needs Terraform modules or Terraform state export for Dedicated capacity provisioning. SE to share sample IaC templates.
